name: @pipeworx/mcp-cricsheet

tools.name: cricsheet_match
tools.description: Full result and scorecard for one cricket match: teams, venue, date, toss, result, and for every innings the batting card (each batter's runs/balls/4s/6s/how out) and bowling card (each bowler's overs/runs/wickets). Covers Test, ODI and T20 International cricket plus the IPL (Cricsheet, ODC-BY). Use cricsheet_find_matches first to get a match_id if you don't already have one.

match_id.description: Cricsheet match id, e.g. 1082591. Get one from cricsheet_find_matches.

tools.name: cricsheet_player_stats
tools.description: A cricketer's career batting and bowling aggregates (matches, runs, average, strike rate, 100s/50s; wickets, bowling average, economy) from Cricsheet's Test/ODI/T20I/IPL match data. Pass a name or partial name ("Kohli", "V Kohli") -- Cricsheet stores short-form names, so this matches case-insensitively and returns a candidate list if the name is ambiguous. Optionally scope to one format with `format`. Covers only matches Cricsheet has scored ball-by-ball, not a player's entire career.

player.description: Player name or partial name, e.g. "Kohli" or "V Kohli".

format.description: Match format: "Test", "ODI", "T20I" (international T20), or "IPL". Omit to search across every format this pack holds.

tools.name: cricsheet_head_to_head
tools.description: Head-to-head record between two cricket teams from Cricsheet's Test/ODI/T20I/IPL match data: total matches, each team's wins, ties/no-results, and the most recent matches with their results. Pass team names as Cricsheet uses them, e.g. "India", "Australia", "Mumbai Indians" (IPL). Optionally scope to one format with `format`.

format.description: Match format: "Test", "ODI", "T20I" (international T20), or "IPL". Omit to search across every format this pack holds.

limit.description: Max recent matches to list, 1-100. Default 10.

offset.description: Pagination offset into the recent-matches list. Default 0.

tools.name: cricsheet_find_matches
tools.description: Search Cricsheet's Test/ODI/T20I/IPL match index by team, format, season, venue and/or player, returning match_id plus date/teams/venue/result for each hit -- use this to discover match_ids for cricsheet_match. With no filters, returns the most recent matches across every format. Provide at least one filter to narrow a specific search.

team.description: Team name, e.g. "England" or "Chennai Super Kings" (IPL).

format.description: Match format: "Test", "ODI", "T20I" (international T20), or "IPL". Omit to search across every format this pack holds.

season.description: Season label as Cricsheet records it, e.g. "2023" or "2007/08".

venue.description: Venue name or partial venue name, e.g. "Lord's".

player.description: Exact player name as Cricsheet stores it (see cricsheet_player_stats to resolve a partial name first).

tools.name: cricsheet_chase_search
tools.description: Compound cricket match search on the second innings (the chase): filter limited-overs matches (ODI, T20I, IPL) by whether the side batting second won or lost, wickets remaining and balls remaining at the end of the chase, date range, season, tournament/event, team, gender and format. Each hit returns target, chase score, wickets lost, balls used, wickets_remaining (10 minus wickets lost) and balls_remaining (scheduled overs minus legal balls bowled; null for rain-affected matches decided by a method such as DLS). Example: T20I chases won with 5+ wickets and 10+ balls to spare since 2024. Source: Cricsheet match data (ODC-BY). Tests are excluded.

second_innings_result.description: Did the side batting second win? Default "won" (a successful chase).

format.description: Match format: "ODI", "T20I" or "IPL". Omit for all three.

min_wickets_remaining.description: Chasing side had at least this many wickets in hand at the end (0-10).

max_wickets_remaining.description: Chasing side had at most this many wickets in hand at the end (0-10).

min_balls_remaining.description: At least this many legal balls unused at the end of the chase (assumes full scheduled overs; 120 in T20, 300 in ODI).

max_balls_remaining.description: At most this many legal balls unused (0 = chase went to the last ball).

team.description: Chasing team name as Cricsheet uses it, e.g. "India".

event.description: Tournament/event name or fragment, e.g. "World Cup" or "Indian Premier League".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-cricsheet forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the cricsheet pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
